name: dep-diff-mcp
description: Translates a lockfile diff into a human-readable upgrade plan. For every dependency bump (npm or PyPI) returns semver class, breaking changes from GitHub release notes, CVEs fixed in the range, migration guide links, and a clear per-package recommendation. Bulk tool ranks up to 50 package changes in parallel by risk (security > caution > review > likely-safe > safe).

GITHUB_TOKEN.description: GitHub token for accessing the GitHub API to read release notes. Optional but recommended to avoid rate limits (60 requests per hour without a token). The server resolves a token in this order: 1. GITHUB_TOKEN environment variable, if set. 2. gh auth token — if the GitHub CLI is installed and authenticated, the server uses that token automatically. 3. Anonymous (60 req/hr). For security, use a fine-grained token with public repository read-only access and rotate periodically.
